subject.title: fix(agents): bound finished bash process session retention

question: Should completed bash process poll/log records be allowed to expire before `OPENCLAW_BASH_JOB_TTL_MS` when the fixed 50-session or 2,000,000-character retention budget is exhausted?
rationale: The code and evidence support the mechanics, but the current behavior is TTL-only retention and the acceptable delayed-poll lifetime is a product/runtime compatibility choice rather than a mechanical defect.

options.title: Accept bounded early eviction
options.body: Merge the fixed count-plus-aggregate budgets and treat an expired completed record under burst load as the supported memory-safety tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve TTL-only poll availability
options.body: Pause this PR and define a different bounded-storage design only after specifying what completed output must remain available through the configured TTL.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded early eviction
recommendation.body: Merge the fixed count-plus-aggregate budgets and treat an expired completed record under burst load as the supported memory-safety tradeoff.
